name: Still Pointz: Breathe & Sit
subtitle: Meditation from 16 traditions
promotionalText: 102 breathing, meditation and movement practices from 16 traditions, sorted by goal: healing, calm, sleep, energy, focus, recovery. Your Watch taps the rhythm.
description:
Still Pointz is a quiet guide to breathing, stillness and gentle movement, drawn from contemplative traditions around the world. Pick a practice, close your eyes and let your iPhone or Apple Watch keep the rhythm.

102 PRACTICES, 16 TRADITIONS
Zen, Theravāda and Forest, Tibetan, Yoga and Prāṇāyāma, Sufi, Christian contemplative, Taoist, Stoic, Shinrin-yoku forest bathing, Thai traditional medicine, Japanese body arts, mind–body medicine, sport and recovery, modern breathwork, Tree Hugs and a wind-down set for sleep. Browse by goal too: Healing, Calm & Anxiety, Sleep, Energy, Focus, Recovery, Nature & Grounding, Quick and Beginner. Every practice says in plain English what it does, who it's good for and how it works. Breath counting, Ānāpānasati, Mettā, Tonglen, Nāḍī Śodhana, Bhrāmarī, Centering Prayer, the Jesus Prayer, Zhan Zhuang, box breathing, 4·7·8, resonance breathing, the physiological sigh and more. Each one tells you where it comes from, why it works and exactly how to do it.

BREATHE BY FEEL
A slow glowing orb shows each inhale, hold and exhale. On Apple Watch, haptic taps mark every phase, so you can practice with your eyes closed and no sound.

MOVE A LITTLE FIRST
Ten warm-up and stretch routines, 2 to 10 minutes each, with a figure for every step: Baduanjin (Eight Pieces of Brocade), Tai Chi cloud hands, Radio Taisō, Makkō-hō, a slow Sun Salutation, Thai hermit stretches (Ruesi Dat Ton), Do-in self-massage, a Tibetan joint warm-up, a lymph flow routine and joint circles head to toe.

SAUNA AND STEAM GUIDE
Heat-safe breathing, gentle bench moves and a session timer for the sauna or steam room, with your heart rate for each session.

PRACTICE BY INTENTION
Sleep, calm, focus and more: tap how you want to feel and get the practices that fit.

YOUR JOURNEY
Every session is kept with its length and your heart rate during the sit. Streaks, minutes by kind, a 12-week calendar and milestones show how far you've come. Sessions are saved to the Health app as Mindful Minutes, and Still Pointz can read your heart rate and HRV to show how you settle over time.

ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app runs the full library on its own: start a practice from your wrist, feel the taps, see your heart rate. Widgets and complications start your favorite practice in one tap, and Siri can start one for you.

FREE AND PRO
The starter set of 34 practices, including the 1-minute Calm SOS, a body scan and Tree Hugs, is free forever. Still Pointz Pro unlocks every practice, every routine, the sauna and steam guide and the full Watch library. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your sessions stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

Still Pointz is for relaxation and general wellbeing. It is not medical advice; check with a doctor before breathwork or sauna use if you are pregnant or have a heart, lung or blood pressure condition.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in. Everything works offline.

Free tier: a starter set of 34 practices (including Calm SOS, body scan and Tree Hugs) and two movement routines. Pro (auto-renewable monthly com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro.monthly and yearly com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro.yearly, both with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro) unlocks every practice, routine, the sauna/steam guide and the Watch library. To see the plans: tap any lock icon, or Journey › Pro, or Settings › Pro. Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen, with the renewal terms, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

HealthKit: reads heart rate and HRV to show how a session went; writes Mindful Minutes (and routines as workouts). Health data never leaves the device.

Apple Watch: the Watch app runs practices with haptic taps for each breath phase.
